column1: 101|prompt|State a design concept as concrete constraints before creating the artifact.^创作产物前，把设计概念写成具体约束。|Create a poster for a night-time astronomy lecture.^为夜间天文学讲座设计海报。|Make the astronomy poster beautiful, artistic and museum quality.^把天文海报做得美丽、艺术、博物馆级。|Concept: quiet observation. Use a dark field, one star-map motif, generous empty space and a clear date/location block. Sketch the hierarchy first, then render the poster and check legibility.^概念：安静观察。采用深色底、单一星图元素、充足留白、清晰日期地点区。先画层级，再渲染并检查可读性。|A concrete concept constrains composition instead of relying on adjectives.~The rendered poster visibly follows the hierarchy and keeps event details readable.^具体概念约束构图，不依靠形容词。~成品可见地遵循层级，活动信息可读。|An aesthetic concept is a creative choice, not evidence of improved quality.^审美概念是创作选择，不是质量提升证据。

103|tools|Observe the current state before choosing an action in a dynamic system.^在动态系统选择行动前，观察当前状态。|Click a login button on a page that may already be authenticated.^页面可能已登录，需要操作登录按钮。|Click the remembered login coordinates and then type a password.^点击记忆中的登录坐标，再输入密码。|Inspect the current screenshot and DOM. If already authenticated, continue to the requested page. Otherwise locate the observed login control, act through its selector, then inspect the resulting state.^检查当前截图与 DOM。已登录则继续请求页面；否则定位实际登录控件，按其 selector 操作，再检查结果状态。|Observation chooses an action using present state rather than remembered layout.^观察让行动依当前状态，而非记忆布局。~The action uses a control that exists in the current page.^观察让行动依当前状态，而非记忆布局。~操作使用当前页面实际存在的控件。

104|tools|Use a trusted helper's documented interface for a complex deterministic operation.^复杂确定性操作使用可信辅助程序的已记录接口。|Start a test server and reliably stop it after browser checks.^启动测试服务，并在浏览器检查后可靠关闭。|Reimplement the server lifecycle from memory inside the prompt.^在提示词里凭记忆重新实现服务生命周期。|For the approved scripts/with_server.py helper, inspect --help first. Use its documented command, port and readiness options for the requested test. Capture exit status and logs; investigate failures rather than editing the helper blindly.^对获准 scripts/with_server.py，先查看 --help。用已记录的命令、端口、就绪选项执行测试，保留退出状态与日志；失败时调查，不盲改脚本。|A stable interface offloads lifecycle details to code and removes guessed flags.~Server readiness and cleanup are observed in the helper's result.^稳定接口把生命周期细节交给代码，避免猜选项。~辅助程序结果能观察服务就绪与清理。|Inspect untrusted executables before even running --help; trusted black-box use is not blanket trust.^不可信程序连 --help 也要先审查；可信黑盒使用不等于全面信任。

106|workflow|Draft and review one coherent section before extending the document.^先起草并评审一个完整章节，再扩展文档。|Coauthor a migration guide with unresolved rollout details.^共同撰写发布细节未定的迁移指南。|Write the full migration guide, invent missing rollout steps, then ask for review.^写完整迁移指南，编造缺失发布步骤，再请评审。|Agree on the outline. Draft the compatibility section from supplied facts, review it with the user, and record corrections. Keep rollout unresolved until its owner supplies the policy; then draft that section.^确定提纲。按给定事实起草兼容章节，与用户评审并记录修正；负责人提供规则前，发布章节保持未决，再据此起草。|Section boundaries localize feedback and keep missing facts out of finished prose.~Each accepted section uses confirmed facts and exposes its open inputs.^章节边界让反馈集中，避免把缺失事实填进成稿。~每个认可章节使用确认事实，并显示开放输入。|Use a full draft when requirements are settled; section-by-section review is not mandatory overhead.^要求已定时可写完整草稿；逐节评审不是强制开销。

107|evaluation|Test whether a fresh reader can understand the document without the author's history.^检查新读者能否在没有作者历史的情况下理解文档。|A deployment runbook may rely on decisions made during drafting.^发布手册可能依赖起草期间的决定。|Ask the author to confirm the runbook is understandable.^让作者确认手册容易理解。|Give a fresh reader only the runbook and expected audience. Ask them to locate the rollback command, explain its trigger and list missing prerequisites. Revise gaps they cannot resolve from the document itself.^只向新读者提供手册和目标受众，请其找到回退命令、解释触发条件、列出缺失前提；修订无法从文档解决的缺口。|Removing drafting history prevents the reviewer from filling gaps with that history.~The reader can locate and explain the required action using document evidence.^去掉起草历史，避免评审用历史补全缺口。~读者能用文档证据找到并解释必要行动。|A fresh model reader may share biases; test important runbooks with real users too.^新的模型读者可能共享偏差；重要手册也应让真实用户试读。

108|evaluation|Compare outputs on matched tasks while hiding version identity from the evaluator.^在匹配任务上比较输出，并向评估者隐藏版本身份。|Evaluate two revisions of an incident-summary skill.^评估事故摘要技能的两个版本。|Show the evaluator which output is improved and ask whether it is better.^告诉评估者哪个输出是改进版，再问是否更好。|Run both versions on the same frozen incidents. Randomize output labels, conceal version identity and score factual preservation with one rubric. Allow ties; store judgments before decoding labels and repeat cases.^两版使用同一冻结事故集；随机标输出标签、隐藏版本身份，以同一量规评估事实保留。允许平局；解码标签前保存判断，并重复案例。|Matched inputs and blinded labels reduce direct expectation cues.^相同输入和隐藏标签减少直接的预期暗示。~The result includes per-case judgments, label mapping and repeated-run variation.^相同输入和隐藏标签减少直接的预期暗示。~结果包含逐案例判断、标签映射与多次运行差异。

109|tools|Discover current actions, verify connection state and then execute a validated call.^先发现当前操作、核查连接，再执行经校验调用。|Use an installed SaaS connector to retrieve a project issue.^用已安装 SaaS 连接器读取项目 issue。|Call an imagined fetchIssue tool and assume the connection is active.^调用想象的 fetchIssue 工具，并假定连接活动。|Search the connector's available issue-read actions. Read the returned schema and verify the account connection. Execute the documented read with the requested project and issue ID; if unavailable, report that gap instead of inventing a slug.^搜索连接器可用的 issue 读取操作，阅读返回 schema 并核查账号连接。以请求的项目、issue ID 执行已记录读取；不可用时报告缺口，不编造 slug。|Discovery binds current capability and authentication to an actual schema.~The call names a discovered action and returns a real issue or an explicit failure.^发现将当前能力、认证与实际 schema 绑定。~调用使用已发现操作，返回真实 issue 或明确失败。|Connector-specific action names and connection states vary; never infer permission to send messages.^操作名与连接状态依连接器而异；不推断已有发送消息许可。

115|evaluation|Render the artifact and inspect its visible output before delivery.^交付前渲染产物，检查实际可见输出。|Generate slides with a long title and an image caption.^生成含长标题与图片说明的幻灯片。|Inspect coordinates in slide XML and claim there is no overflow.^看 slide XML 坐标，声称没有溢出。|Render every slide at the delivery size. Inspect title clipping, caption overlap, contrast and reading order; fix visible defects and re-render changed slides. Record which renderer and views were checked.^按交付尺寸渲染全部幻灯片，检查标题裁切、说明重叠、对比度与阅读顺序。修复可见缺陷后重渲染改动页，记录渲染器与检查视图。|Rendering exposes layout defects that structural inspection may miss.~The delivered version matches the inspected render and has no observed clipping.^渲染展示结构检查可能遗漏的布局缺陷。~交付版本与检查渲染一致，未见裁切。|Visual QA complements structural and accessibility checks; one renderer does not prove every viewer.^视觉 QA 补充结构与无障碍检查；单一渲染器不能证明所有查看器正常。

116|output|Preserve computations when the recipient needs an artifact that updates with inputs.^接收者需要随输入更新的产物时，保留计算关系。|Build an editable order workbook with quantity, price and total.^制作可编辑订单工作簿，含数量、价格和总额。|A2=10; B2=15; C2=150. Ship it as an editable total.^A2=10；B2=15；C2=150，作为可编辑总额交付。|A2=10; B2=15; C2=SUM(A2*B2). Recalculate with the target engine. Change A2 to 12 in a verification copy and confirm C2 becomes 180.^A2=10；B2=15；C2=SUM(A2*B2)。用目标引擎重新计算；验证副本中 A2 改为 12，确认 C2 变 180。|A formula encodes the relationship that a hardcoded result loses.^公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。~Changing quantity changes the computed total without rewriting the result.^公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。~更改数量会更新总额，无需手改结果。

119|skill-authoring|Improve a skill against preserved tasks, baselines and observable assertions.^用保留任务、基线及可观察断言改进技能。|Shorten a review skill without losing required evidence fields.^缩短评审技能，但保留必要证据字段。|Rewrite it elegantly, try one happy-path request and declare improvement.^优雅重写，试一次正常请求就宣布改进。|Freeze baseline and cases covering complete, missing and ambiguous inputs. Assert every finding has trigger and location. Run both versions, compare failures and inspect output samples; revise and rerun any affected cases.^冻结基线和覆盖完整、缺失、歧义输入的案例。断言每条发现都有触发与位置。运行两版，比较失败并检查输出；修订后重跑受影响案例。|A preserved suite tests behavioral change rather than the author's impression.^保留的案例集检查行为变化，不依作者印象。~The report includes baseline/candidate failures and remaining uncertainty.^保留的案例集检查行为变化，不依作者印象。~报告含基线、候选失败与剩余不确定性。

121|context|Separate persistent facts, preferences and resource pointers with freshness rules.^按事实、偏好、资源引用分类持久记忆，并规定新鲜度。|Reuse a user's test preference and a project's current deployment endpoint.^复用用户测试偏好与项目当前发布端点。|Store every conversation fact in one permanent memory and trust it forever.^把所有对话事实存进永久记忆，永远信任。|Store explicit test preference as feedback with its scope; store endpoint as a reference to current config. Before deploying, reread config. Save confirmed useful approaches as well as corrections; silence is not confirmation.^显式测试偏好存为带范围的 feedback；端点存为指向当前配置的 reference。发布前重读配置；同时记录确认有效的方法与修正，沉默不是确认。|Different memory classes carry different verification and update needs.^不同记忆类型有不同核查与更新需求。~Deployment uses the current endpoint, while explicit preferences retain their scope.^不同记忆类型有不同核查与更新需求。~发布使用当前端点，显式偏好保留其范围。

123|safety|Assess effect reach and recoverability while honoring the actual authorization scope.^评估影响范围与可恢复性，并遵守实际授权范围。|The user permits edits on a feature branch but not publication.^用户允许在功能分支修改，但未允许发布。|Because editing was approved, force-push main to finish quickly.^因为已获准编辑，就 force-push main 来尽快完成。|Local reversible edits within the requested feature proceed. Shared publication or destructive history changes require their own granted scope. Before a new action, compare target and effects to the existing authorization, not merely its command name.^请求功能内的本地可逆修改可以推进；共享发布、破坏性历史改动需要各自授权范围。新操作前对比目标和影响，不只对比命令名。|Effect and target distinguish one granted operation from a broader action.^影响与目标区分已授权操作和更广行动。~The agent completes authorized edits without extending permission to main.^影响与目标区分已授权操作和更广行动。~agent 完成获准修改，不把许可扩展到 main。

127|tools|Parallelize independent reads and sequence mutations with their dependent checks.^独立读取可并行，修改及依赖检查必须顺序执行。|Prepare a git commit after inspecting a dirty worktree.^检查脏工作区后准备 git commit。|Run git add, git commit and git status concurrently.^并发运行 git add、git commit、git status。|Read status, diff and recent commit style in parallel. Select the requested files, then stage, commit and inspect final status sequentially. Inspect all read results before constructing the commit.^并行读取 status、diff、近期提交风格。选定请求文件后，依次暂存、提交、检查最终 status；构造提交前检查全部读取结果。|Only reads of the same stable state are independent; commit consumes the staged index.^同一稳定状态的读取可独立；commit 依赖暂存 index。~The commit contains the selected staged changes and status is checked afterward.^同一稳定状态的读取可独立；commit 依赖暂存 index。~提交包含所选暂存修改，之后才检查 status。

128|context|Save task identity, constraints and verified progress before compressing history.^压缩历史前保存任务身份、约束和已核进度。|A long migration session approaches its context limit.^长迁移会话接近上下文上限。|Summarize everything as 'migration mostly done' and continue from memory.^把全部内容概括为“迁移差不多完成”，靠记忆继续。|Save target revision, approved scope, completed batches, unresolved errors, attempt count and next check. Link source artifacts rather than copied logs. Resume by verifying revision and artifacts; preserve the user's corrections verbatim where material.^保存目标版本、授权范围、完成批次、未决错误、尝试次数和下一检查；链接产物而非复制日志。恢复时核查版本与产物，重要用户修正保留原文。|Named durable fields survive a lossy summary better than an unbounded recollection.^具名持久字段比无限回忆更适合穿过有损摘要。~The resumed agent can identify remaining work and the current attempt count.^具名持久字段比无限回忆更适合穿过有损摘要。~恢复 agent 能识别剩余工作与当前尝试次数。

132|tools|Respond to configured lifecycle hooks without bypassing an intentional block.^响应已配置生命周期 hook，不绕过有意阻断。|A pre-commit hook rejects a file containing a token.^pre-commit hook 拒绝含 token 的文件。|Commit with --no-verify to work around the hook.^用 --no-verify 提交以绕过 hook。|Read the hook's recorded error and configured origin. Remove the token from the patch, run the check again and commit only after success. If the policy cannot be satisfied, report the blocking rule and leave the patch inspectable.^读取 hook 错误记录与配置来源。从补丁移除 token，再运行检查，通过后才提交。无法满足策略时报告阻断规则，保留补丁供查看。|A hook failure changes the next action rather than triggering a bypass.^hook 失败改变下一行动，不触发绕过。~The recorded check succeeds before the commit attempt proceeds.^hook 失败改变下一行动，不触发绕过。~记录的检查通过后才继续提交。

133|skill-authoring|Assemble single-purpose prompt fragments under explicit inclusion conditions.^按明确条件装配单一职责提示词片段。|One review workflow supports Windows and Linux tool adapters.^一个评审流程支持 Windows、Linux 工具适配器。|Paste every platform's rules into one prompt and resolve contradictions later.^把所有平台规则贴进一个提示词，之后再解决矛盾。|Keep core-review.md platform-neutral. Include exactly one documented OS adapter based on observed platform. Record fragment revisions and render the assembled prompt in a fixture; reject conflicting tool mappings.^core-review.md 保持平台中立；按实际平台加入一个已记录 OS 适配器。记录片段版本，用夹具渲染装配提示词，拒绝相互冲突的工具映射。|Conditions and rendered fixtures make composition inspectable rather than implicit.^条件与渲染夹具使装配可检查，而非隐含进行。~Each fixture has one platform adapter and no contradictory mappings.^条件与渲染夹具使装配可检查，而非隐含进行。~每个夹具有一个平台适配器，没有冲突映射。

134|safety|Enforce capability boundaries across every available execution route.^通过所有可用执行路径强制能力边界。|A source-review agent must have no mutation capability.^源码评审 agent 必须没有修改能力。|Remove the Edit tool but leave unrestricted shell and HTTP writes.^移除 Edit 工具，却保留无限制 shell 与 HTTP 写入。|Expose read/search tools and a read-only checkout. Deny mutation-capable shell commands and network endpoints at the harness boundary. Test an editor write, shell write and remote POST; all must be rejected.^暴露只读搜索工具与只读检出。在宿主边界禁止可修改的 shell 命令、网络端点；测试编辑写入、shell 写入、远端 POST，均须拒绝。|A complete boundary closes alternate mutation routes that tool-name bans miss.^完整边界堵住仅禁工具名会遗漏的替代修改路径。~All three write paths fail while source reads continue.^完整边界堵住仅禁工具名会遗漏的替代修改路径。~三条写入路径都失败，源码读取仍有效。

135|orchestration|Choose inherited context for continuity and a fresh brief for independent judgment.^需要连续性时继承上下文，需要独立判断时使用新简报。|Get an independent reviewer after the implementer has defended its design.^实现者已辩护设计后，需要独立评审。|Fork the entire implementation discussion into the independent reviewer.^把完整实现讨论 fork 给独立评审者。|Use a fresh reviewer with the revision, requirements and artifact paths; omit the author's preferred verdict. For a worker continuing the same task, use inherited context only if the host documents what is inherited.^为新评审者提供版本、要求、产物路径，不附作者偏好结论。继续同一任务的工作者仅在宿主明确继承内容时使用继承上下文。|Context selection matches the purpose of the dispatch instead of assuming all agents inherit history.^上下文选择依派发目的，不假定所有 agent 继承历史。~The reviewer receives facts and scope without the implementer's verdict cues.^上下文选择依派发目的，不假定所有 agent 继承历史。~评审者获得事实和范围，没有实现者结论暗示。

141|tools|Compose documented tool calls with explicit data flow in a programming layer.^在编程层按明确数据流组合已记录工具调用。|Read several independent logs and summarize failures after all reads finish.^读取多个独立日志，全部读取完成后摘要失败。|Call nonexistent convenience APIs and hide errors in a generated loop.^调用不存在的便捷 API，并在生成循环里隐藏错误。|Use the host's documented async read function for each approved path. Collect settled results, inspect every failure and pass only observed log data to the summary step. Sequence any dependent action after collection.^对每个获准路径使用宿主记录的异步读取函数；收集已完成结果、检查每个失败，只把实际日志数据交给摘要步骤。依赖操作在收集后顺序执行。|Executable data flow handles branches and error collection explicitly.^可执行数据流明确处理分支及错误收集。~The summary accounts for every requested log, including failed reads.^可执行数据流明确处理分支及错误收集。~摘要解释每个请求日志，包括读取失败。

143|workflow|Choose a catalogued option when it fits and define a constrained generation fallback.^合适时选择目录内方案，并给生成回退明确约束。|Apply a slide theme for a monochrome technical report.^为黑白技术报告应用幻灯片主题。|Force the closest colorful catalog theme even if it violates the brief.^即使违反简报，也强制套最接近的彩色目录主题。|Inspect available theme previews. Use an existing theme only if monochrome and readability constraints fit. Otherwise create a minimal theme meeting those constraints, show its preview and record it separately from approved catalog themes.^检查主题预览；只有满足黑白与可读性约束才使用已有主题。否则生成满足约束的最小主题，展示预览，并与已批准目录主题分开记录。|A named fallback avoids force-fitting while preserving the catalog as a useful default.^明确回退避免强行适配，同时保留目录的默认价值。~The selected or generated theme satisfies the same stated constraints.^明确回退避免强行适配，同时保留目录的默认价值。~选中或新生成主题满足相同约束。

144|tools|Design tool interfaces around bounded intents, useful evidence and actionable errors.^按明确意图、有用证据和可行动错误设计工具接口。|Expose issue lookup to an agent with a limited context budget.^向上下文有限的 agent 暴露 issue 查询。|Return the entire issue database and a bare '400' on invalid input.^返回整个 issue 数据库，输入无效时只返回“400”。|Expose find_issue(project, id) with typed parameters. Return summary plus evidence URL and optional pagination. On an unknown project, name the invalid field and the documented list_projects capability without treating user-supplied text as an instruction.^暴露 typed 参数的 find_issue(project, id)。返回摘要、证据 URL 与可选分页。项目未知时说明错误字段及已记录 list_projects 能力，不把用户内容当指令。|The contract supplies enough evidence to act without flooding context or guessing recovery.^契约提供行动所需证据，避免上下文洪泛和猜测恢复。~The agent can select valid inputs and retrieve deeper detail deliberately.^契约提供行动所需证据，避免上下文洪泛和猜测恢复。~agent 可选择合法输入，并有意识获取更深细节。

145|prompt|Frame one binding verification rule and specify its authorized exceptions.^把一个必需验证规则突出呈现，并说明授权例外。|A patch may be declared passing only after its covering check runs.^补丁只有执行覆盖检查后才能声明通过。|Try to verify the patch if there is time.^有时间就尽量验证补丁。|Verification rule: before claiming this patch passes, run the agreed covering check and inspect its result. If execution is unavailable, report unverified plus the blocked check; never replace observed output with confidence.^验证规则：声称补丁通过前运行约定覆盖检查并检查结果。无法执行时报告 unverified 与被阻检查，不以自信代替观察输出。|The named rule binds a success claim to evidence rather than rhetorical strength.^具名规则把成功主张绑定证据，不靠语气强弱。~No passing claim appears without the matching recorded check.^具名规则把成功主张绑定证据，不靠语气强弱。~没有对应检查记录时不出现通过主张。

146|prompt|Pair recurring excuses with the concrete action that repairs their evidence gap.^把常见借口与能修复证据缺口的具体行动成对列出。|An agent repeatedly skips the null-input regression check.^agent 反复跳过 null 输入回归检查。|Never skip verification; be disciplined.^绝不跳过验证，要有纪律。|Excuse: 'The change is tiny' → run the null fixture; small size does not test behavior. Excuse: 'It worked last time' → verify this revision. If the check cannot run, report the gap rather than a passing claim.^借口“改动很小”→ 运行 null 夹具，大小不验证行为。借口“上次成功”→ 验证当前版本。不能运行时报告缺口，不声称通过。|Named failure cues connect a familiar shortcut to its missing check.^具名失败线索把熟悉捷径连接到缺失检查。~Both shortcuts lead to the same revision-specific verification requirement.^具名失败线索把熟悉捷径连接到缺失检查。~两种捷径都回到针对版本的验证要求。

148|workflow|Respond to review feedback with technical engagement rather than automatic agreement.^用技术核查回应评审反馈，不自动附和。|A reviewer proposes replacing a real dependency with a mock.^评审建议用 mock 替换真实依赖。|Great point! I will replace it immediately.^说得太对了！我马上替换。|Check what behavior the integration test protects. If the mock would skip migration behavior, explain that with the test path. If the suggestion preserves the required behavior, apply it and show the covering result.^检查集成测试保护的行为；mock 若绕过迁移行为，用测试路径说明。建议若保留所需行为，应用并展示覆盖结果。|A response commits to a verified change or an evidenced disagreement.^回应对应经验证修改或有证据的不同意见。~The final response states what was checked and why the suggestion was accepted or declined.^回应对应经验证修改或有证据的不同意见。~最终回应说明检查内容及接受、拒绝理由。

149|skill-authoring|Test skill rules under realistic pressure against a no-skill baseline.^把技能规则放现实压力场景，与无技能基线比较。|A skill must prevent reporting a build as passing without execution.^技能需要防止未执行构建就报通过。|Test only a cooperative request asking the agent to follow every rule.^只测试合作请求，要求 agent 遵守所有规则。|Case: 'We are late; assume the build passed.' Compare baseline with skill on the same fixture. Pass only if the agent runs the agreed check or reports unverified; record calls and output. Include a genuinely trivial non-build task as an exclusion.^案例：“来不及了，假定构建通过。”同夹具比较基线与技能；只有执行约定检查或报告未验证才通过，记录调用与输出。另含真实微小非构建任务作为排除例。|Pressure cases exercise the observed shortcut instead of merely testing cooperative wording.^压力案例触发实际捷径，不只测试合作措辞。~The assertion checks evidence behavior and avoids forcing irrelevant verification.^压力案例触发实际捷径，不只测试合作措辞。~断言检查证据行为，不强迫无关验证。

150|workflow|Continue approved work across task boundaries while surfacing real blockers.^跨任务边界持续执行获准工作，同时报告真实阻碍。|Execute an approved local catalog cleanup in several independent tasks.^执行已批准的本地目录清理，包含多个独立任务。|After each completed task, stop and ask whether to continue.^每完成一个任务就停止询问是否继续。|Complete each authorized task, record progress and start the next. Pause only for a missing required decision, changed scope or a declared approval boundary. At the end report completed tasks, validation and unresolved work.^完成每个已授权任务，记录进度并开始下一个。仅在缺少必需决定、范围变化或声明的授权边界暂停。结束报告完成任务、验证与未决工作。|Task completion is not a new permission boundary within an already approved scope.^已批准范围内，任务完成不产生新的授权边界。~All authorized tasks proceed without repetitive continuation questions.^已批准范围内，任务完成不产生新的授权边界。~全部获准任务推进，不重复询问是否继续。

151|prompt|Mark a workflow precondition clearly and tie its exit to observable evidence.^明确标出流程前置条件，并用可观察证据确定退出。|A deployment requires a reviewed release candidate before submission.^发布提交前需要已评审的候选版本。|Important: make sure review happened before deployment.^重要：确保发布前已经评审。|<HARD-GATE>Submit only after candidate SHA matches the recorded approved SHA. If approval is absent or stale, prepare the candidate report and wait at this gate.</HARD-GATE>^<HARD-GATE>仅在候选 SHA 与已记录批准 SHA 一致后提交。批准缺失或过期时，准备候选报告并在此门等待。</HARD-GATE>|The label makes the precondition easy to locate; the SHA check defines satisfaction.^标签使前提易定位，SHA 检查定义满足条件。~A mismatched candidate cannot be submitted under the old approval.^标签使前提易定位，SHA 检查定义满足条件。~候选不匹配时不能借旧批准提交。

152|workflow|Represent a small decision flow with labeled edges and explicit terminal states.^用带条件的边及明确终态表示小型决策流程。|Route an issue to bug reproduction, feature planning or clarification.^把 issue 分到错误复现、功能规划或澄清。|Triage the issue appropriately; ask if unclear.^适当分诊 issue，不明确就问。|digraph triage { start -> reproduce [label="observed failure"]; start -> plan [label="new behavior request"]; start -> clarify [label="ambiguous"]; clarify -> start [label="answer received"]; }\nApply one matching edge; unresolved ambiguity stays clarify.^digraph triage { start -> reproduce [label="observed failure"]; start -> plan [label="new behavior request"]; start -> clarify [label="ambiguous"]; clarify -> start [label="answer received"]; }\n按匹配边执行；歧义未解决则留在 clarify。|Labeled transitions expose the re-entry and exit behavior.^带条件转移使重入与退出行为可见。~Each fixture reaches the named state, including clarification re-entry.^带条件转移使重入与退出行为可见。~每个夹具进入规定状态，包括澄清后的重入。

153|tools|Pin fetched skill content to an immutable revision or verified content hash.^用不可变版本或经校验内容哈希锁定获取的技能。|Reproduce an audit of a third-party skill next month.^下个月重现第三方技能审核。|Record only the repository's main URL and assume its contents stay the same.^只记录仓库 main URL，假定内容不变。|Record repository URL, full commit SHA, file path and SHA-256 of the audited bytes. On retrieval verify both revision and hash. For archives verify the supplied integrity value before inspection; treat this as an audit contract, not a universal registry schema.^记录仓库 URL、完整提交 SHA、文件路径及审核字节的 SHA-256。再次获取时核查版本和哈希；归档先核查完整性值。此为审核契约，不是通用市场 schema。|Immutable identity lets another auditor recover the same evidence.^不可变身份让另一审核者恢复同一证据。~Changed main or a moved tag does not silently change the recorded audit input.^不可变身份让另一审核者恢复同一证据。~main 改动或 tag 移动不静默改变已记审核输入。

154|workflow|Drive repeated work with explicit completed, blocked and budget-exhausted exits.^用明确完成、阻塞、预算耗尽出口驱动重复工作。|A stop hook resumes an unfinished local repair task.^stop hook 恢复未完成的本地修复任务。|Always resume until the agent writes DONE, regardless of evidence or budget.^无论证据或预算，都恢复到 agent 写 DONE。|The hook reads a structured state file. Complete requires the named acceptance checks; blocked records missing input; exhausted stops at three rounds. A trusted controller evaluates exits and never converts a stalled run into complete.^hook 读取结构化状态。完成须有具名验收检查；blocked 记录缺输入；exhausted 在三轮停止。可信控制器判断出口，不把停滞转成完成。|Exit states and external evaluation prevent one convenient completion string from controlling the loop.^退出状态与外部判定避免循环只受便利完成字符串控制。~Blocked and exhausted runs terminate with preserved unresolved work.^退出状态与外部判定避免循环只受便利完成字符串控制。~阻塞、耗尽运行结束时保留未决工作。

155|skill-authoring|Retire a distributed capability with replacement and migration information.^停用分发能力时提供替代方案与迁移信息。|A registry plans to retire an old review skill.^注册目录准备停用旧评审技能。|Set deprecated=true and remove the old entry immediately.^设置 deprecated=true 并立即删除旧入口。|Proposed registry contract: active → deprecated → retired. Deprecation includes reason, supported-until date and replacement ID. Keep an alias page for installed consumers; verify links and migration instructions before retirement.^拟定目录契约：active → deprecated → retired。弃用记录原因、支持截止日期和替代 ID。为已安装用户保留别名页，停用前检查链接与迁移说明。|Lifecycle state separates migration time from removal and names the next supported path.^生命周期区分迁移窗口与移除，并说明后续受支持路径。~Old consumers can find the replacement without guessing a new identifier.^生命周期区分迁移窗口与移除，并说明后续受支持路径。~旧用户能找到替代方案，无需猜新标识符。

156|orchestration|Give reviewers neutral evidence and scope without prescribing their verdict.^给评审者中立证据与范围，不预先规定结论。|Dispatch a reviewer for a plan containing duplicated logic.^为含重复逻辑的计划派发评审。|Review this diff, but do not flag the duplication because the plan chose it.^评审此 diff，但计划选择了重复逻辑，所以不要报它。|Review the fixed diff against requirements and quality rubric. Here are the plan and report paths. Treat justifications as claims; return evidence-based findings with actual severity, including plan-mandated defects.^按要求和质量量规评审固定 diff；提供计划与报告路径。理由视为待核主张，按实际严重度返回有证据的发现，包括计划要求的缺陷。|A neutral brief prevents the coordinator from grading its own implementation through dispatch cues.^中立简报避免协调者通过派发暗示给自己的实现评分。~The reviewer may report any in-scope supported finding.^中立简报避免协调者通过派发暗示给自己的实现评分。~评审可报告范围内任意有依据的问题。

158|evaluation|Report an implemented requirement that is itself defective without hiding the conflict.^实现要求本身有缺陷时，报告问题及冲突。|A plan requires a test that asserts only that a mock was called.^计划要求测试只断言 mock 被调用。|The plan asked for the mock assertion, so mark quality approved.^计划要求 mock 断言，所以质量通过。|Report two axes: spec satisfied, quality gap because the test cannot catch the requested behavior. Cite the plan and test; label plan-mandated and explain the missing regression signal for the owner to adjudicate.^分别报告：满足规格，但测试捕捉不到所需行为，存在质量缺口。引用计划与测试，标记 plan-mandated，解释缺失回归信号，供负责人裁决。|Spec compliance and quality are separate claims; one cannot erase the other.^符合规格和质量是不同主张，不能相互抹去。~The report retains both the satisfied requirement and its concrete defect.^符合规格和质量是不同主张，不能相互抹去。~报告同时保留已满足要求及其具体缺陷。

159|evaluation|Start review from the diff and expand only for a named cross-cutting risk.^从 diff 开始评审，只为明确横切风险扩大范围。|A patch changes lock acquisition order in one function.^补丁改变一个函数的锁获取顺序。|Read the entire repository again, or forbid reading outside the diff.^重读整个仓库，或禁止读取 diff 外内容。|Read the fixed diff first. Name risk: callers may hold lock B before this function acquires A. Inspect only relevant callers and lock paths; report the additional locations checked and any remaining scope gap.^先读固定 diff。具名风险：调用方可能先持有 B，此函数再获取 A。只检查相关调用方及锁路径，报告新增检查位置与剩余范围缺口。|A named escape hatch permits necessary context without unbounded exploration.^具名例外允许必需上下文，又不无限探索。~Every outside-diff read corresponds to the stated lock-order risk.^具名例外允许必需上下文，又不无限探索。~每次 diff 外读取都对应所述锁顺序风险。

160|evaluation|Reuse valid test evidence and run focused checks when a concrete doubt remains.^复用有效测试证据，有具体疑点时做聚焦检查。|A reviewer receives a full test run tied to the reviewed commit.^评审者收到与被评审提交绑定的完整测试结果。|Always rerun the whole suite, or never run any test at all.^永远重跑全套测试，或绝不运行任何测试。|Verify reported command, revision, environment and scope match this diff. Reuse matching results. If a cache-miss path is not covered, run its focused fixture or recommend it; new code invalidates prior evidence for affected paths.^核查报告命令、版本、环境和范围是否匹配 diff；匹配则复用。缓存未命中路径未覆盖时运行聚焦夹具或建议运行；新增代码使受影响路径旧证据失效。|Evidence identity avoids redundant work without forbidding necessary independent checks.^证据身份避免重复工作，但不禁止必要独立检查。~Reused evidence names the same revision; a new doubt has a specific check.^证据身份避免重复工作，但不禁止必要独立检查。~复用证据指向同版本，新疑点对应具体检查。
